name: ai-branches
title: AI Branches
description: A compact chat window where each sent message can be edited, and an edit grows a new branch. Arrows page through versions, a small tree on the right maps every branch, and clicking a node switches the conversation.
use: People may want to rewrite a prompt and keep both answers side by side for comparison.
avoid: The tiny version arrows and narrow tree rail demand a fine pointer, and you must supply the flat message history.
a11y: Controls are labelled and focus is moved for you, but the tree nodes are tiny targets and the streaming caret is hidden from screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded dark chat card titled Trip planning with a branch count at the top right. Bubbles alternate: right-aligned grey user messages with tiny edit and version arrows, left-aligned assistant paragraphs. A narrow rail of connected dots runs down the right edge.
behaves: Hovering a message lights it and reveals its controls; the pencil opens an inline editor, and sending adds a forked reply that types itself in. Version arrows slide between siblings, and the rail's nodes preview and switch branches.
customise: Pass a flat messages array with ids and parents, a reply function that may stream, an onChange callback and a title; the tree layout and styling stay fixed.
weight: light: A short message list and a small SVG tree, animated only when something changes.

props.name: reply
props.type: (prompt: string, history: BranchMessage[], signal: AbortSignal) => BranchReply
